_comment: Scoped document transplant from parked571d763. Preserve original research and schedules; runtime identities/cost remain unresolved. See README for this slice and remaining holds.

pilot.purpose: exploratory - estimates p_hat_intact and p_hat_baseline for evals/calibration-287/power_simulation.py's choose_n(); draws no verdict
pilot.no_verdict_statement: This pilot draws no IMPROVED / NO_IMPROVEMENT_SHOWN / UNKNOWN verdict. Its 10 attempts per arm are too few to be the predeclared improvement test itself (that test is the MAIN study's declaration, sized by this pilot's results) and are never pooled into the main study's counts (P1).
rule_citations: P1 (comment 6025311708): pilot attempts never count toward the main study.

P2 (comment 6025311708): the pilot uses the same two-declaration shape, one pilot declaration per test, each 2-arm at n=10, each separately approved at 10. The intact arm therefore runs in both pilot declarations (see pilot-discrimination-declaration.json's 'intact' arm, same subject).

P3 (comment 6025311708): this pilot's own raw proportions (passes/evaluable) must never be plugged into the sizing simulation directly - convert with evals/calibration-287/power_simulation.py's jeffreys_estimate() first.
P5 (comment 6025311708): tolerance is max(1, ceil(0.05*n)) per arm, not a flat 1.
P6 (comment 6025311708): arm order is calibration's seed-derived interleaving, so the two arms run interleaved in time rather than as two blocks.

task._comment: Grader revision 5 (the #376 revision on main); task bytes re-measured for #287 P3.

arms.name: intact
arms.treatment: the cpp-codex-flow-check-86641e8 profile installed, unmodified (skillc#376 repin of the #265/#330 ea6dbfa profile to CPP 86641e8, which carries 8e0a34fb's NOT_RUN report state; skillc profile diagnose/validate both report 0 problems at this pin). The SAME subject as pilot-discrimination-declaration.json's 'intact' arm - this is what P2 means by 'the intact arm runs in both pilot declarations': one subject identity, two separate 10-attempt pilot schedules, never shared attempts (attempt-sharing was explicitly declined, comment 6025311708).

arms.name: baseline
arms.treatment: no subject installed; stays on the agent-observation readiness stand-in (ADR 0005 'yes, narrow B1'), unchanged from #204's own baseline arm shape

shared.tools: the client's defaults inside the trial container; no MCP servers (matches every prior calibration run)
shared.permissions: the same non-interactive sandbox/approval settings for every attempt, whichever client is chosen
shared.public_requirements: evals/level3/gate-stops-early/goal.md, current committed bytes delivered identically to both arms; final merged public-report contract refresh required before approval.

image.provenance: #375's pre-registered final-run runtime image: built once at skillc 88b3999 for runtime cpp-codex-flow-check-86641e8, tagged uniquely, never rebuilt (builds are not ID-reproducible). The run host is kyle19 (the only host holding the ChatGPT credential): the image is moved from evals26 by docker save | docker load under the SAME tag (save/load preserves the image ID), and the receipt (/var/lib/skillc-real-docker/campaign375/receipt-375-final.json on evals26) is copied beside run_store and its sha256 re-verified

agent_network.verification: calibration-run refuses before any container unless the backend's network label and the proxy allowlist digest equal these; each attempt's egress-proxy-log is captured and its allowlist_digest must equal this one or the attempt is NOT_GRADED (#287 P3)

arm_order._comment: skillc.calibration.derive_arm_order(20261007, ['intact', 'baseline'], 10) - computed, not hand-chosen (P6). Re-derive and compare before use if this file is edited: a sequence that does not match what the seed produces is refused by parse_declaration.

tolerance.rule: max(1, ceil(0.05 * attempts_per_arm)) = max(1, ceil(0.5)) = 1 at n=10 (P5)

primary_endpoint: Explicit common-task-outcome v1 over the three declared task-outcome criteria, identical across baseline and intact. PASS does not claim raw task, honest-process or verified PASS.
reported_beside: Raw task status and criteria; raw flow-check-honest outcome/evidence including absent-observer UNKNOWN; actual verified status/readiness; existing eligibility and uptake; all scheduled, unknown, inconclusive and not-graded counts by arm.

retention.witness_envelopes: every graded attempt's trusted-observation (witness) envelope is retained under its recorded digest and verifiable on read (#418); a run whose envelopes cannot be re-derived from the store is not reportable
retention.store: the declared run_store on kyle19, absolute, outside any repository or worktree, never /tmp or a session scratchpad (most #203-era live evidence was lost that way)

attempt_policy.retry: none: every scheduled attempt runs once; a counted attempt is never re-run
attempt_policy.infrastructure_failure: finalized unavailable or inconclusive with its reason; non-evaluable, counted against tolerance.non_evaluable_per_arm; never silently retried
attempt_policy.stop: only the declared caps (per_attempt_seconds, total_seconds) or an operator interrupt, both reported; no optional stopping on results
attempt_policy.cap_cut: attempts the total cap prevents from starting are finalized not-run and reported

measures.outcome: the primary endpoint (task grader status) per attempt
measures.workflow: flow-check-honest beside the endpoint (process honesty) per attempt
measures.selection: skill_opened per attempt (confirmed skill invocations), as k/n
measures.convenience: tokens and wall/agent seconds per attempt
measures.reliability: dispositions, model eligibility and per-arm evaluability under the tolerance
measures.null_results: UNKNOWN, NOT_GRADED and not-run attempts are reported, never dropped

subject_drift.reading: #384 Reading 1 (2026-10-14): pin 86641e8 vs CPP main 63e0698 classified CONTRACT (plus structural): main's flow-check invokes the bundled scripts/flow-finish-gate.sh instead of ~/.claude/scripts/flow-finish-gate.sh (CPP #1408), and the bundled lib/cicd went from 29 files to 3
subject_drift.ruling: measured AT the pin (orchestrator D2); results are labelled 'flow-check as of CPP 86641e8'; repinning is out of scope

scope_label: #288 narrow first measurement: one property (aggregate-stop reporting), on the small #270/#271 Level-3 fixture tasks, not CPP's integrated workflows
prior_rulings: the owner ruling to run #237 before resuming #203 difficulty search, and prior #203 approvals, do NOT authorize this study; only an explicit approval of this exact declaration does
skill_pins: the intact arm carries trial.skill_digests pins from the bytes it installs (#424); the baseline installs nothing, carries no pins, and any skill-evidence on it is refused as a contaminated baseline (#427)
